💡 ggwave | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling data communication between devices using audible or ultrasonic sound waves, particularly useful for air-gapped systems or simple device pairing.
✨ Key Features: • Tiny data-over-sound library • FSK-based transmission protocol • Error correction codes (ECC) for robustness • Supports RAW waveform generation and analysis • Works with any audio backend via callbacks
📖 Summary: ggwave is a tiny C++ library that enables data transmission through sound waves, including ultrasound. It uses a simple FSK modulation and error correction codes to ensure robust communication between air-gapped devices, supporting various platforms like Arduino and Python.
